Public captures from Termux on 2026-10-18. Deezer/JioSaavn artist search and profile, Deezer top songs, Apple artist search/lookup. Captures retain original response structures but remove preview/playback/account-oriented fields and unrelated JioSaavn recommendation modules. Original body hashes and sizes are in manifest.json. Apple lookup capture predates the explicit recent sort request; tests verify decoding rather than inventing ordering. youtube-profile.json is the real Gur Sidhu profile captured through OMMR in the preceding Known Unknowns album verification; related artists are excluded so their metrics cannot become the requested artist metrics. No credentials or account data.

mb-profile.json and mb-recordings.json: captured from the official MusicBrainz artist and recording-browse endpoints for 60bb7169-b83b-4603-a319-7bcbd1130cc9 on the same date, with a meaningful application/contact User-Agent and sequential requests. Catalogue recording-count is not a streaming play total or a popularity ranking.
